The '''Wyld Woods''' is a location in the [[Rift Dimension]]. It is based on the {{zone|Wilderness}}.

{{RiftGuide|Help out Bughunter|Help out Inverted Sirius|Enigma: Tough Bark|Enigma: Woods Flower Pot|Enigma: Wither Cage|Enigma: Pressurized|Enigma: Two Plates|more=4|souls=9}}

== Purpose ==
The '''Wyld Woods''' are full of a network of trees, full of [[NPCs]]. Walking along the trees are [[Argofay Branchstrutter]]s, which serve no purpose. [[Odonata]]s can be found floating around the trees, and the player can use an [[Empty Odonata Bottle]] to convert the item into a [[Bottled Odonata]]. Additionally, [[Larva]]e can be found crawling across tree branches, and [[Larva Silk]] can be harvested from them using a [[Larva Hook]].
